thread:
anna: RFC follow-up: telemetry sidecar evacuation playbook. Goal is to split telemetry-ingest + lineage-writer to reduce deploy blast radius. high-level plan in thread. cc @sam @diego @nora

sam: Quick question: synchronous vs async handoff for lineage? Async is preferable but requires durable buffering and backpressure.

diego: Agree async. Proposal: in-process ring buffer + local WAL with bounded checkpointing. WAL ships to new service; shipper has backoff and rate caps.

nora: Obs gates needed before any ramp: ingest_success_rate >= 99.5%, backlog_bytes < 50MB, p99_ship_latency < 500ms. Also add per-tenant completeness sampling.

anna: Phases:
- Alpha: deploy new services to staging, enable WAL but no prod traffic
- Shadow: sidecar writes duplicated to new services for 72h (no read change)
- Canary: 2% production writes to new services, sidecar stays fallback
- Ramp: increase with automated gates and reconcilers running
- Cutover: switch read-path, keep fallback for 1 week

sam: Compatibility: publish JSON schema and small client lib. Maintain backward compatibility for 8 weeks and provide mapping shim.

diego: Reconciler design: enumerate WAL segments, diff against new store, report per-tenant divergence. Throttle IO to 5MB/s per region.

anna: Runbook snippet:
``nGate: ingest_success_rate >= 99.5 AND backlog_bytes < 50MB
If backlog_bytes > 200MB OR ingest_success_rate < 98% -> PAUSE_RAMP and flip feature flag
Pause: curl -X POST $FF/toggle?flag=telemetry_sidecar_evacuate&env=prod&value=0
``n
deploy-bot: Shadowing enabled -> env=prod cohort=shadow-72h id=canary-1759999999-1 :satellite:

nora: Owners + actions: anna (arch/pm) write appendix; sam (telemetry) owns WAL + client lib; diego (runtime) owns shipper + reconcilers; nora (obs) owns gates/dashboards. Timeline: alpha this week, shadow next, canary in 2 weeks.

sam: Cost note: expected +10-15% write/storage while shadowing. We'll file a short budget ask.

anna: I'll post the appendix in the RFC thread and schedule a 30m sync Fri. If no objections by EOD tomorrow, alpha opens. :white_check_mark:
